description: Use this when someone asks what is happening, what to do, or where to go in a US town on a given day or evening: trivia, karaoke, live music, open mics, comedy, card and board games, bingo, game nights, markets, festivals, talks, family and kids' events, sports and more. Works for "near me" when the app shares the person's rough town; if it does not and no town is named, ask the person for a town (like "Denver, CO", "Tampa, FL" or "Sacramento, CA") or a ZIP. For "this weekend" give date and end_date (up to 7 days); for "tonight" give starts_after 17:00. Today's answers leave out events that started over an hour ago. Returns up to 25 events, soonest first, each with its Suumer page to cite (suumerPage) and, for most, the original source page. Price is shown only when the source gives it; there is no free-only filter. Not for tickets, bookings, or events outside the US. Read-only.

date.description: The first day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the town's own time. Work out "today", "tomorrow" or "Friday" from the person's current date. Leave it out for today.

end_date.description: The last day, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 6 days after date. Use it for "this weekend" or "this week". Leave it out for one day.

kind.description: One kind of event; leave it out (or "all") for everything. live_music covers concerts, bands, orchestras and choirs; card_games covers euchre, poker, cribbage and bridge.

radius_miles.description: How far from the town, in miles. Default 15. Use more for a small town or when few events come back.

starts_after.description: Only events starting at or after this local time, HH:MM. Use 17:00 for "tonight" or "this evening".

town.description: The US town and state the person asked about, like "Denver, CO", "Tampa, FL" or "Sacramento, CA", or a 5-digit ZIP code. Leave it out to use the rough town the app shares.

name: find_events
title: Find local events by town and day
